BetweenSus.RoleDef.label: innocent crewmate
BetweenSus.RoleDef.description: You have no special power. Do your tasks, watch the others, vote well.
BetweenSus.RoleDef.tip: Find the impostors before they find you.

li.label: Sharp eyes
li.description: You see every colonist's actions like anyone else. Trust what you observe, not what you are told.

BetweenSus.RoleDef.label: impostor
BetweenSus.RoleDef.description: You are an impostor. Eliminate the crew without being caught.
BetweenSus.RoleDef.tip: Stay close to your fellow impostors, but do not look like it.

li.label: Cover
li.description: You look like any crewmate. Blend in: repair, work, and follow the crew.

li.label: Kill in the dark
li.description: Strike only when nobody can see you, and when no camera is on the room.
